cues.text: Mitsuru, Yukari and Fuuka walk along a forest path.
Yukari and Mitsuru look down; Mitsuru folds her arms. Fuuka turns and walks on, and the others follow her further up the path.
Mitsuru takes out her phone, looks at it and answers. She holds the phone out between them.
Yukari pulls out her own phone and makes a call.
